shrinkdb.title: Database
shrinkdb.error.noDatabase: Shrink Database needs a target database.
shrinkfile.title: Files
agentjob.start.title: Start Job
agentjob.start.description: Starts the job now, at its first step. Agent runs it in the background — the outcome lands in the job's history, not here.
agentjob.stop.title: Stop Job
agentjob.stop.description: Asks Agent to stop the running job. A job that is not running reports an error rather than stopping silently.
agentjob.enable.title: Enable Job
agentjob.enable.description: Lets the job's schedules fire again. Does not start it now.
agentjob.disable.title: Disable Job
agentjob.disable.description: Stops the job's schedules from firing. A run already in progress keeps going.
agentjob.new.title: New Job…
agentjob.new.description: Creates an empty job on this server and targets it at the local server, which a job needs before it can run at all. Add its steps and schedules from the job's Properties.
agentjob.new.field.name: Name
agentjob.delete.title: Delete Job…
agentjob.delete.description: Deletes the job together with its steps, its history and its links to any schedules. A schedule shared with another job survives; one only this job used goes with it.
